sahneler.metin: When Christchurch was hit by an earthquake, the CTV Building collapsed.
It killed one hundred fifteen people inside, most of the quake's deaths.
It had been designed in the 1980s.
Its concrete frame used an obsolete non-ductile design.
Engineers inspected it after earlier quakes.
It was allowed to stay open.
Its consulting firm's head said it didn't meet his own standards.
A Royal Commission examined how it was approved.

aciklama:
CTV Building collapsed in the Christchurch earthquake. The cause: an obsolete non-ductile concrete design failing under strong shaking.
